name: app-store-connect-mcp
description: App Store Connect tools for Claude — apps, TestFlight builds and testers, customer reviews, sales/finance reports, and team users

key_id.title: Key ID
key_id.description: 10-character App Store Connect API Key ID, e.g. ABC1234567.

issuer_id.title: Issuer ID
issuer_id.description: Team Issuer ID (UUID) from App Store Connect → Users and Access → Integrations.

private_key_path.title: Private Key Path
private_key_path.description: Absolute path to your downloaded .p8 private key file.

tools.name: list_apps
tools.description: List apps in your account with optional filters

tools.name: get_app
tools.description: Get details for a single app by ID

tools.name: list_app_store_versions
tools.description: List App Store releases for an app

tools.name: get_app_infos
tools.description: List App Info records (age rating, store state)

tools.name: list_builds
tools.description: List recent builds (newest first)

tools.name: get_build

tools.name: list_beta_groups

tools.name: invite_beta_tester

tools.name: delete_beta_tester
tools.description: Remove a beta tester from your team

tools.name: add_testers_to_beta_group
tools.description: Add testers to a beta group

tools.name: remove_testers_from_beta_group
tools.description: Remove testers from a beta group

tools.name: submit_build_for_beta_review
tools.description: Submit a build for TestFlight beta review

tools.name: list_customer_reviews

tools.name: get_customer_review

tools.name: respond_to_review

tools.name: download_sales_report

tools.name: list_user_invitations

tools.name: invite_user
tools.description: Invite a new user to your team

tools.name: asc_healthcheck
tools.description: Resolves the credential the way real tools do, then makes one authenticated request to api.appstoreconnect.apple.com. Reports which source supplied the credential, whether api.appstoreconnect.apple.com accepted it, the round-trip time, and a plain-English hint distinguishing 'no credential' from 'credential rejected' from a 'api.appstoreconnect.apple.com-side problem'. Call this when a real tool fails and you want to know which hop broke. Read-only; never returns the credential itself.
